evidence: Several-mm-thick monolithic silica aerogels with a density of 10 mg cm −3 were coated with an ,2-nm-thick ZnO layer by alternating 300 s exposures to diethyl zinc/H2O at 177 °C at a pressure of 10 Torr. Between each exposure, the reactor was evacuated below 0.24 Torr and then purged with ultrahigh purity Ar for 200 s.
